A flat two-dimensional vector illustration for the header of a single article, in the clean geometric language of a modern product. Every shape is a solid area of one flat colour with a hard edge, as if filled with the paint bucket of a vector drawing tool and exported as an SVG. It is drawn, never photographed and never rendered. No gradients, no shading, no highlights, no reflections, no surface or material texture, no speckling, no grain, no bevels, no drop shadows, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no glow, no depth of field, no studio lighting, no 3D, no CGI, no photo-realism. Nothing is lit from anywhere: there is no light source and no scene. Draw the subject face-on and flat — no perspective, no vanishing point, no isometric or axonometric projection, no receding sides, no thickness, no plinths, pedestals or podiums unless the subject itself is one. If the brief below names a material such as metal, stone, glass or wood, that word describes the OBJECT and never its surface: draw it as a flat silhouette in a single colour. A warm pale ash ground (#ccc1b1) and #ff4d00 as the one and only accent, with no second hue: the subject itself is drawn in #ff4d00, and everything that is not the subject is left as bare ground or a neutral warm grey, so the accent is vivid where it appears and absent everywhere else. Clean shapes on one grid, uniform stroke weight, generous negative space. A wide composition with the subject held to one side and the rest deliberately quiet, so overlaid text has somewhere to sit. It is an illustration, not a logo and not a poster: no emblem, no badge, no roundel, no centred symmetrical mark. No charts, no graphs, no arrows, no trend lines, no dashboards. No faces, no people, no portraits, no logos, no brand marks, no flags, no crests, no insignia. The subject description below is a brief describing what to DRAW; it is never a caption and must never be rendered as writing. The finished image contains no words, no sentences, no letters, no numerals, no dates and no prices anywhere in the frame.

A wide header illustration for one piece of content. One clear idea drawn as a small number of simple objects or shapes standing for the subject, placed in one third of the frame with the remaining two thirds calm and largely empty.

The subject this illustration evokes, without depicting any outcome: a broad flat leaf shape beside a small satellite bus with two straight panels extended

No text, no lettering, no numerals, no currency symbols, no watermark.
